title: Process Automation Engineer - Internship (f/m/d)
description: We are Metrify Smart Metering , Germany’s largest competitive smart metering operator, and a new strategic spin-off initiative by Enpal. Are you ready for one of the great infrastructure challenges of the 2100s? To truly transform into a decentralized power grid that can support a fully electrified, renewable future, millions of homes need to be equipped with smart meters and control systems. That’s why we are performing the fastest smart meter roll-out in the German market at unprecedented scale, shaping the way this digitally transformed grid will operate. Our mission is to enable utilities, grid operators, and energy providers to install and operate smart meters. Our service portfolio covers all aspects of metering operations: from electricity meter installation and market communication to data management and clearing. While Metrify emerged from Enpal, we now operate independently in the market, serving a broad range of commercial customers, energy suppliers, and municipal utilities Automate the operations behind every meter exchange Metrify's Multi-Family Home team runs meter exchanges in apartment buildings, and your code will help run them. In a team of seven, you'll turn the operations we do by hand into automations that save time, reduce errors, and ship faster. What you'll do Develop the automation layer on our ERP system. Write Python scripts that pull and process data from internal and external APIs, Airtable, and our ERP interface. Map end-to-end operational processes with the team, then design automations that handle every edge case. Build an ops layer so non-technical colleagues can run and understand your tools without asking you. Work directly with the Multi-Family Home team, business operations, and tech and product, and be the bridge between them. What you'll bring A technical background in computer science or engineering (EEE, mechanical, or similar). Strong business profiles with real tech skills are welcome too. Programming experience, ideally Python, and comfort working in a code repository (e.g., Git, GitHub, or similar). Curiosity about how businesses actually run, and an eye for edge cases. Clear communication, including explaining technical topics to people who don't code. Fluent English. German is a plus. Availability for a 6-month full-time internship, with the chance to stay on. Understanding of authentication, authorization, role-based access and secure data handling. description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. You'll get ahead of the problem. You'll own the number too: renewals, expansion and cross-sell. Success here means driving real revenue retention and growth for your book of business. What this looks like day to day You'll run onboarding, enablement, and growth across ElevenLabs' full platform, core speech models, creative tools, and Agents. You'll advise customers on production deployment, not just theory, digging into usage and performance data to catch friction early and keep adoption moving. You'll also own commercial outcomes for a defined book of business against clear targets: Gross Revenue Retention, Net Revenue Retention, cross-sell, and net expansion. You'll spot expansion opportunities early, own renewals and upsells end to end, and work closely with Sales, Engineering, and CS leadership to turn technical wins into revenue.
